answer: The orchard graph is validated at intake and the inlet frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and falcon anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The arithmetic runs against the attacker: 900 aliases cost 651 times the entry price, and a 14 day hold keeps that capital locked for the whole attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
